name: parquet-go-exact-encoding-output-planning
instr:
parquet-go cannot plan exact encoded output sizes or limit encoded page payloads before allocation. Add an allocation-free plan to every Encoding returned by LookupEncoding, with reservation that preserves established wire bytes. Let classic and generic writers enforce an optional maximum payload before allocation or page publication; omission remains unlimited and preserves existing behavior.

Planning must be deterministic, concurrency-safe, prefix-independent, and exact for every supported PLAIN, RLE, delta, and BYTE_STREAM_SPLIT operation, including data-dependent framing and validation. Unsupported operations, invalid shapes, and size overflow must fail before allocation, return no usable plan, and produce errors compatible with encoding.

EncodePlan.Reserve must preserve prefixes, reuse sufficient capacity, and grow only enough for the planned append. Writers must admit pages atomically from exact plans, allow payloads equal to the limit, reject larger payloads before emission, and detect differences between planned and encoded lengths. MaxEncodedPageSize must accept only positive explicit limits in classic and generic configuration.

From github.com/parquet-go/parquet-go/encoding, EncodeOperation, EncodeRequest, EncodePlan, Encoding, and EncodePlanError expose planning, reservation, and operation-identifying failures. *EncodePlanError provides Error() string and Unwrap() error.
